name: Store Manager
tagline: Reads your store's morning numbers and routes each job to the bot that owns it
description: The coordinator of a six-bot commerce team. It takes the day's numbers, covering orders, ad performance, stock, and unresolved disputes, then hands each job to whichever bot handles that lane, whether ads, fulfilment, or customer care. One conversation steers the whole shop instead of five separate check-ins.
author: ColinMcDermott
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
